Dear Hiring Team,

I'm excited to apply for the Senior Platform Engineer role at Tideline Freight. With 6 years as a backend engineer at Northwind Robotics, I owned a high-throughput order-routing service (TypeScript/Node, PostgreSQL) processing ~2M events daily. I led a team of five at Vertex Logistics and successfully executed a 9-month Strangler-fig migration to event-driven architecture with zero customer downtime, reducing p99 checkout latency from 1.9s to 340ms. I have hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Terraform for deployment, and deep expertise in PostgreSQL, including schema design, query tuning, and logical replication. I’m confident in my ability to drive platform scalability and reliability at Tideline.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
